from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792544931/attempts/5b17e8f43661473aad6b536871505fc9/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter, deque\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]\n    seen = set()\n    for r in range(h):\n        for c in range(w):\n            color = grid[r][c]\n            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:\n                continue\n            q = deque([(r, c)])\n            seen.add((r, c))\n            cells = []\n            while q:\n                y, x = q.popleft()\n                cells.append((y, x))\n                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):\n                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:\n                        seen.add((yy,xx))\n                        q.append((yy,xx))\n            r0, r1 = min(y for y,x in cells), max(y for y,x in cells)\n            c0, c1 = min(x for y,x in cells), max(x for y,x in cells)\n            fill = 2 if (r1-r0+1) % 2 == 0 else 7\n            for y in range(r0+1, r1):\n                for x in range(c0+1, c1):\n                    if grid[y][x] == bg:\n                        out[y][x] = fill\n    return out\n'''
file=program_dir/'task-89c74053.py'
file.write_text(source)
# Build the demonstration grid from its four hollow rectangular outlines.
demo=[[0]*28 for _ in range(25)]
def frame(g,r0,r1,c0,c1,color):
    for c in range(c0,c1+1): g[r0][c]=g[r1][c]=color
    for r in range(r0,r1+1): g[r][c0]=g[r][c1]=color
frame(demo,2,7,2,7,6)
frame(demo,13,17,0,4,4)
frame(demo,15,17,21,23,1)
frame(demo,20,23,6,9,1)
expected=[row[:] for row in demo]
for r in range(3,7):
 for c in range(3,7): expected[r][c]=2
for r in range(14,17):
 for c in range(1,4): expected[r][c]=7
expected[16][22]=7
for r in range(21,23):
 for c in range(7,9): expected[r][c]=2
actual=transform(demo)
print('demo matches:',actual==expected, 'saved:',file)
# Run on the given test grid.
test=[[1]*17 for _ in range(12)]
for r in range(5):
 for c in range(10,15):
  if r in (0,4) or c in (10,14): test[r][c]=3
for r in range(4,10):
 for c in range(3,9):
  if r in (4,9) or c in (3,8): test[r][c]=9
answer=transform(test)
print('test output:')
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in answer))
